core: Trans-synaptic adhesion in synapse membrane assembly
qualifier: excitatory (NMDA receptor, PSD-95) synapses
name: Trans-synaptic adhesion in excitatory synapse membrane assembly
rationale: Members are neurexin-neuroligin, SALM and receptor phosphatase adhesion organizing pre- and postsynaptic membranes with NMDA receptor and PSD-95 clustering, unlike confusables centred on inhibitory synapses, synaptic potentials or general synapse-assembly regulation.

qualifier: glycinergic, in touch and respiratory control
name: Glycinergic inhibitory neurotransmission in sensory and respiratory control
rationale: Members share inhibitory (glycinergic/GABAergic) dampening of nerve transmission, including hyperekplexia, touch perception and neural control of breathing, whereas confusables concern GABA metabolism and transport or locomotor behaviour.

core: Transition and heavy metal transport and homeostasis
qualifier: zinc, copper, manganese and cadmium, not iron
name: Zinc, copper and manganese transport and cadmium detoxification
rationale: Members cover SLC39/SLC30 zinc transport, copper, manganese, cobalt and cadmium transport, metallothionein binding and detoxification, distinguishing them from confusables built on MTF1 metal-response transcription or iron and heme handling.

core: Mitochondrial protein import and membrane organization
qualifier: processing, cristae and outer membrane contacts
name: Mitochondrial protein import, processing and membrane organization
rationale: Members concern import and processing of proteins and RNA into mitochondria, cristae and outer-membrane organization, fusion and calcium uptake, unlike confusables on respiratory-chain assembly or mitophagy and fission regulation.

qualifier: with skeletal muscle development
name: Alpha-dystroglycan O-mannosylation and skeletal muscle development
rationale: Most members are DAG1 O-mannosyl and matriglycan glycosylation and their dystroglycanopathy defects, joined by muscle fiber and diaphragm development, distinguishing them from GAG/keratan glycosylation and dystrophin-glycoprotein complex confusables.

qualifier: stimulated through the HPA axis
name: Hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal stimulation of glucocorticoid secretion
rationale: All members describe stimulated corticotropin and cortisol/glucocorticoid secretion, whereas confusables concern responses to CRH, corticosteroids or stress and feeding behaviour.

qualifier: c-FLIP inhibition at the DISC
name: Procaspase-8 activation and c-FLIP inhibition in TRAIL signaling
rationale: Members cover TRAIL signaling, procaspase-8 dimerization and its inhibition by c-FLIP, distinguishing them from broader Fas/extrinsic apoptosis and necroptosis confusables.

qualifier: cadherin trafficking, degradation and cleavage
name: Cadherin adherens junction assembly, trafficking and degradation
rationale: Members concern calcium-dependent cadherin (CDH1, CDH11) adhesion, adherens junction assembly and cadherin trafficking, degradation and apoptotic cleavage, unlike confusables on EMT and regulation or maintenance of cadherin adhesion.

qualifier: phase I oxidation and non-glucuronide conjugation
name: Phase I oxidation and phase II conjugation of xenobiotics
rationale: Members are CYP/FMO oxidation, methylation, acetylation and sulfonation of drugs, toxins and phytochemicals with AhR signaling, distinguishing them from confusables on drug transporters, glucuronidation-linked ADME and aldehyde detoxification.

qualifier: de novo head-group synthesis and intermembrane lipid transfer
name: Glycerophospholipid de novo synthesis and intermembrane lipid transfer
rationale: Members cover synthesis of PC, PE, PS, PI, PG, cardiolipin and plasmalogens, lysophospholipid hydrolysis and non-vesicular lipid transfer, unlike confusables dominated by acyl-chain remodeling, sphingolipid or endocannabinoid metabolism.

core: Choline supply and high-energy phosphate metabolism
qualifier: phosphocreatine and mitochondrial ATP/ADP exchange
name: Choline supply for acetylcholine and phosphocreatine energy buffering
rationale: Loose theme: members join choline uptake, acetylcholine synthesis and choline-releasing phospholipid hydrolysis with creatine/phosphocreatine and mitochondrial ATP/ADP transport, the energetic arm distinguishing it from cholinergic transmission, choline catabolism and neurotransmitter transporter confusables.

qualifier: mucopolysaccharidosis disorders
name: Lysosomal glycosaminoglycan degradation and mucopolysaccharidoses
rationale: Members are lysosomal breakdown of heparan, chondroitin/dermatan, keratan sulfate and hyaluronan and the mucopolysaccharidoses caused by its defects, distinguishing them from GAG biosynthesis and glycosphingolipid catabolism confusables.

qualifier: SLC26 transport of sulfate and oxalate
name: SLC26 anion exchange of sulfate and oxalate
rationale: All members are SLC26-mediated sulfate and oxalate transport, unlike confusables on bicarbonate transporters or sodium-coupled carboxylate transport.

qualifier: in cardiac muscle
name: Desmosomal cell-cell adhesion in cardiac muscle
rationale: Members share desmosome assembly, intermediate filament anchoring and cardiomyocyte adhesion affecting ventricular action potential, distinguishing them from adherens-junction, epithelial polarity and hemidesmosome confusables.

qualifier: renal acidification and enamel mineralization
name: Bicarbonate transport in renal acidification and enamel mineralization
rationale: Members are SLC4 bicarbonate transporters and their renal tubular acidosis defects plus enamel mineralization and tooth eruption, the dental context separating them from SLC26, carbonic anhydrase and sulfonate transport confusables.

qualifier: PALB2 bridging BRCA1 and BRCA2, SDSA D-loop resolution
name: PALB2-bridged BRCA1-BRCA2 homologous recombination and D-loop resolution
rationale: Members concern PALB2 binding to BRCA1 and BRCA2 in homology-directed repair and D-loop resolution by SDSA, distinguishing them from single-strand annealing, end resection and BRCA2-RAD51 or BARD1 defect confusables.

qualifier: cystine-glutamate exchange protecting against ferroptosis
name: Cystine-glutamate exchange and glutathione turnover suppressing ferroptosis
rationale: Members link cystine import, glutamate homeostasis, cysteine metabolism, glutathione transport and catabolism to ferroptosis suppression, unlike confusables on glutathione synthesis disorders or general ROS detoxification.

qualifier: fibronectin-driven mesenchymal migration and spreading
name: Integrin-fibronectin adhesion driving mesenchymal cell migration and spreading
rationale: Members combine integrin and syndecan matrix interactions, fibronectin matrix formation, focal adhesion and stress fiber assembly with fibroblast/EMT migration programmes, distinguishing them from plain ECM modules and MET-PTK2 confusables.

qualifier: follicle growth, ovulation and luteal phase
name: Ovarian follicle maturation, ovulation and corpus luteum cycle
rationale: Members cover antral follicle growth, ovulation, luteinization, luteolysis and the estrous cycle, unlike confusables on progesterone response, male gonad and gonadotropin responses or oocyte meiotic maturation.

qualifier: Th2 cytokines, mast cells and eosinophils
name: Th2 cytokine, mast cell and eosinophil allergic immunity
rationale: Members span Th2 differentiation, IL-4/5/13/33 signaling, FcεRI mast cell activation, IgE switching and eosinophil responses, distinguishing them from Fc-gamma/BCR, IL-17/IL-10 and IL-2/STAT5 cytokine confusables.

qualifier: arterial blood pressure via vasoconstrictors and relaxation
name: Vascular smooth muscle tone in arterial blood pressure regulation
rationale: Members concern arterial smooth muscle contraction and relaxation, vasoconstriction by catecholamines and endothelin, cGMP effects and systemic/pulmonary pressure, unlike confusables on NO synthesis, renal or renin-angiotensin control and generic smooth muscle contraction.

qualifier: vessel wall remodeling and endothelial apoptosis
name: Vascular wound healing and blood vessel wall remodeling
rationale: Members regulate vascular wound healing, blood vessel remodeling, smooth muscle adaptation and endothelial apoptosis, distinguishing them from angiogenic sprouting and smooth muscle phenotypic-switching confusables.

qualifier: nucleotide sugars, dolichol oligosaccharides, congenital glycosylation disorders
name: Sugar-donor and dolichol-oligosaccharide synthesis in congenital glycosylation disorders
rationale: Members are nucleotide-sugar synthesis and transport, dolichol-linked oligosaccharide assembly, N-glycan, GPI and glycolipid glycosylation and the CDGs caused by their defects, unlike confusables on lysosomal glycolipid catabolism or terminal glycan elongation.

core: Rho and ILK-driven actin cytoskeleton remodeling
qualifier: SRF transcriptional target programme
name: Rho- and ILK-driven actomyosin remodeling with SRF target expression
rationale: Members combine RHO-ROCK/PAK and PINCH-ILK-parvin control of stress fibers and spreading with SRF actin and contractile target modules, distinguishing them from integrin-matrix adhesion and platelet activation confusables.

qualifier: receptor return from endosome to plasma membrane
name: Endosomal receptor internalization and recycling to plasma membrane
rationale: Members concern plasma membrane to endosome transport, endosome organization and recycling of receptors back to the surface, unlike confusables on Golgi-endosome traffic, synaptic receptor trafficking or clathrin cargo selection.
